notes: Synchronous calls: profile is a gRPC server (services/profile/server.go:71 pb.RegisterProfileServer, line 69 grpc.NewServer). It makes no gRPC client calls in the files given (no dialer import in cmd/profile/main.go or services/profile/server.go). Outgoing calls are to its datastores: MongoDB at ProfileMongoAddress mongodb-profile:27017 (config.json:8, read at cmd/profile/main.go:37, connected via mongodb:// URI at cmd/profile/db.go:162, queried at services/profile/server.go:137) and memcached at ProfileMemcAddress memcached-profile:11211 (config.json:9, read at cmd/profile/main.go:40, client built at main.go:42, used at server.go:109). Protocols: MongoDB wire protocol via go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver (go.mod:16); memcached protocol via gomemcache (go.mod:6). That the compose service names equal these host names is not stated beyond the matching service keys.
Messages: no topics, no producers, no consumers, no consumer groups in these files.

Registry: registers with consul. cmd/profile/main.go:62 registry.NewClient(*consulAddr), consulAddress consul:8500 (config.json:2); services/profile/server.go:78 s.Registry.Register(name, s.uuid, s.IpAddr, s.Port) with name = srv-profile (server.go:25) called once in Run() before srv.Serve(lis) (server.go:84); Deregister on Shutdown (server.go:89). The AgentServiceRegistration (registry/registry.go:85-90) sets only ID, Name, Port, Address: no Check, TTL, interval or DeregisterCriticalServiceAfter. Heartbeat interval, failure timeout and cleanup interval: not stated in these files (library default, not in these files; consul agent config is not among the files). No heartbeat or goroutine in profile code refreshes the registration, so no heartbeat that runs independently of request processing is stated in these files.

Container, replicas, health check: image obsplacement-hotel-reservation:6ecb09706140 (harness compose line 33, default of HR_APP_IMAGE; upstream compose line 49 names deathstarbench/hotel-reservation:latest), entrypoint profile (upstream compose line 50), replicas: 1 (upstream compose line 57). No health check in the files given: no HEALTHCHECK in hotelReservation/Dockerfile and no healthcheck key in either compose file; restart: always at upstream compose line 55.

Telemetry: traces only. Jaeger agent address jaeger:6831 (config.json:3, jaegerAddress, read at cmd/profile/main.go:49, passed to tracing.Init at main.go:55 as LocalAgentHostPort, tracing/tracer.go:37); upstream compose publishes 6831:6831/udp for jaeger (line 230). Reporter BufferFlushInterval 1 * time.Second (tracing/tracer.go:36). Sampler probabilistic, default ratio 0.01 (tracing/tracer.go:14), overridden by env JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO (tracer.go:20); harness compose sets JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO from ${HR_JAEGER_SAMPLE_RATIO:-1} (line 35) and JAEGER_DISABLED from ${HR_JAEGER_DISABLED:-false} (line 36); cfg.FromEnv() at tracer.go:42. Spans created in code: memcached_get_profile (server.go:107) and mongo_profile (server.go:135), plus gRPC server interceptor otgrpc.OpenTracingServerInterceptor (server.go:61). Logs: zerolog ConsoleWriter to os.Stdout (cmd/profile/main.go:21), no log exporter. Metrics: none stated in these files.
